results.title: parse_duration() ignores seconds
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `parse_duration("1m30s")` returns `60` instead of `90`. The `s` unit is accepted by the pattern but contributes nothing. `parse_duration("45s")` returns `0`.

results.title: word_count() miscounts extra whitespace
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `word_count("hello world")` (two spaces) returns `3`, and `word_count("")` returns `1`. Words separated by any amount of whitespace, including tabs and newlines, should count once: `word_count("one\ttwo\nthree")` should be `3`. Empty or whitespace-only text has 0 words.

results.title: chunk() drops the last partial chunk
results.author: VARUN3WARE
results.body_snippet: `chunk([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 2)` returns `[[1, 2], [3, 4]]`. The trailing `5` is silently lost. Expected `[[1, 2], [3, 4], [5]]`. Any leftover items should end up in a final, shorter chunk.
